name: Giving And Receiving
overview: Scripture reveals a profound principle in the act of giving and receiving, emphasizing generosity as a pathway to blessing rather than loss. Proverbs teaches that those who scatter freely increase, while those who withhold tend toward poverty, highlighting the spiritual and practical benefits of open-handedness. Jesus instructs believers to give with sincerity, not for human recognition, promising that the measure used in giving will be the measure received in return. Furthermore, the New Testament exhorts believers to support the weak and assures that God will supply all needs, underscoring that it is more blessed to give than to receive.
